# WU-S4 receipt

Status: DONE (no deploy)

## Part A -- predictive lease edge (hooks/session_budget_guard.js judge())
- Edge fires before the warn branch when tokens + (tokens/calls) * reserve > stop; reserve = closeout_reserve_calls || 3. Stop deny unchanged. Kill switch CPP_LEASE_EDGE=off.
- test_session_budget_guard.py: 20/20. V-LIFE-EDGE-BEFORE-STOP (WU-1H3 replay: first edge call 5, 322,500 < stop 500,000), V-LIFE-EDGE-QUIET-EARLY, V-LIFE-EDGE-KILL, V-LIFE-EDGE-MUTANT-RED PASS.
- Mutant (edge branch dropped): replay shows no edge, so EDGE-BEFORE-STOP would go red.

## Part B -- physical-call pricing (tools/route_admission.py, route-floors.json)
- slim-t2: physical_ratio 2.4, physical_ratio_n 4. calls_physical = ceil(calls * ratio) feeds cost; output has `calls` and `calls_physical` (per worker and total).
- test_route_estimator.py: 9/9. V-EST-PHYSICAL-1H4: 7 declared -> 17 physical, 550,545 vs 442,155 (+24.5%, inside 25%, close to the edge). V-EST-PHYSICAL-CONTROL: profile without the field unchanged.
- Mutant (ratio ignored): V-EST-PHYSICAL-1H4 FAIL (166,320), 8/9 as required.
- test_gsd_mission_admission.py: 43/43.

## Install
- install/L2-edge.patch = git diff --binary e86cafc4 over the 3 source files + 2 test files.
- sha256 26299356086712843A423E7AF9DC9CF953A3064A3899907742AB2D1EF8A6E3E3
- Coordinator installs with tools/lifecycle_install_apply.ps1.

## WU-S5
